title: The master holds released work and messages the worker that holds it
description: A released fixture item held with master hold is skipped by dispatch for several cycles while its lease, history and candidate stay; master message reaches the live worker at its next sync, which acknowledges it, survives a control plane restart before receipt, and carries unread into the successor's prompt; master release resumes dispatch; workers and the coordinator cannot hold, release or message.

steps.name: hold, message, sync, restart, successor and release on a fixture install
